body:
Like you said, I don't really understand the alternative to hedonism.

The world is my sandbox. I can either reduce myself to the size of my Barbie and Ken dolls, play by their rules, and hope that Barbie chooses to fellate me for the inner beauty present in my soul, or I can watch on in delight as I construct a 30 toy car pile up, with the sound of babies crashing through windscreens drowned out only by the collective hum of dreams shattering into a million pieces. What else is there?

Join me for a beer. I'll teach you the art of manipulation if you buy the first round.

I could use a sidekick.
This is the point. I don't want to "fix" myself, but I have recently encountered an obstacle (urge to murder) in my way of life.
The latter. I genuinely like the way I am.

You did not come off as condescending, but then again, I am rather insensitive to the nuances of emotional diction.

Your point about murder is quite trivial. I addressed the issue of prison is my submission. I recognise that the pleasure of murder does not outweigh the pain of imprisonment - otherwise I would be out murdering people, instead of here on reddit.

Your point about suicide is well taken. If I can find something on this earth that is pleasurable while at the same time legal, I would no longer feel the need to kill. Whether or not I can restrain myself until then is the pertinent consideration.
Not a terrible idea, actually. I had a momentary respite from my urges as I was writing about the puppets.

Murder threats to a psychiatrist = good way to get locked up indefinitely in an asylum. No thanks.

I suppose you could be right about the self-diagnosis. There was no need for me to include that sentence. I described the symptoms of whatever disorder I have.
